method: All 3717 frames decoded with ffmpeg -fps_mode passthrough to 320x180 RGB. Per-pair scores: mean abs RGB diff, HSV (16x4x8) histogram L1/2 distance, edge change ratio, 10x10 block-change fraction, and a motion-compensated block residual (80x40, +-6 px search). Candidate set (mad>12 | hd>0.25 | ecr>0.55 | blk>0.35 | mad>3x and hd>3x local +-12 median | ecr>2.5x local median) = 526 frames. Because frames 0-1200 are a stylised high-motion fight (one-take tracking camera, smears, flashes), every frame 0-1199 was inspected on 10x10 filmstrips (160x90) plus 266/320-px detail strips for 29-58, 74-103, 255-323, 341-352, 398-499, 527-544, 572-589, 693-734, 2056-2096, 2863-2886. Frames 1200-3716 (calm dialogue scenes) were inspected on step-2 filmstrips and every metric spike there (mc local ratio>3, hd>0.15, mad>12, ecr>0.5; 80 frames) was explained. Each cut verified on n-1|n|n+1 320-px sheets (/tmp/gt/sheets/bc_cuts_0[1-5]*.png, doubts in bc_doubts_01.png). Fade boundaries from per-frame mean luminance.
pts_note: time_base 1/1000, stream start_time 0, pts of frame 0 = 0; pts deltas are 41/42 ms (regular 24000/1001 CFR) except the last frame: 3715 -> 3716 jumps 167 ms (pts 154947 -> 155114) because packets are missing at the cut end of the extract. Decoded frame count 3717 equals packet count.
